author: Activiti Modeler maintainers
tooling: Written by hand; checked against osv-scanner.toml by scripts/cve-scan-check.py

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-47884
vulnerability.description: Spring Framework: use of XsltView in a Spring MVC application can result in SSRF and RCE if the application has a /** mapping that results in view rendering and the view name is not set explicitly.

statements.impact_statement: The server renders no XSLT views: it has no XsltView, no view resolver of its own and no template engine, its controllers are JSON REST endpoints, and its only catch-all mapping is a static resource handler that returns files without rendering a view. The embeddable libraries declare Spring MVC only as provided, so the host application's own Spring version applies to them; a host that adds XSLT views decides for itself. The fix exists only in Spring Framework 6.2.20 (Enterprise Support Only) and 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4, not supported by a stable Activiti release).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-47890
vulnerability.description: Spring Framework: Spring MVC and WebFlux applications are vulnerable to Server-Sent Events stream corruption when SSE is used with view fragments.

statements.impact_statement: The server uses no Server-Sent Events (no SseEmitter, ServerSentEvent or text/event-stream) and renders no view fragments. The fix exists only in Spring Framework 6.2.20 (Enterprise Support Only) and 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4, not supported by a stable Activiti release).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-113730
vulnerability.description: OGNL: the optional stricter-invocation block list can be bypassed through java.lang.reflect proxies (a hardening of a secondary layer; the primary access control is the MemberAccess of the integrating framework).

statements.impact_statement: OGNL 3.4.4 is repackaged inside org.mybatis:mybatis 3.5.19 (org.apache.ibatis.ognl). The advisory matters only to an application that evaluates attacker-controlled OGNL expressions. MyBatis evaluates OGNL only for the expressions written in mapper XML, which for the engine are packaged in the activiti-engine jar; user input supplies values, never expression text, and the server configures no custom mapper. The fixed OGNL (3.4.13 and newer) ships only in MyBatis 3.6.0, which activiti-engine 9.0.0 and 8.8.1 cannot run on (the engine fails to start with NoSuchMethodError TypeHandlerRegistry.register).
